## About
F M Motors & Fleet Services is a family-owned, locally operated repair shop on Oakcliff Rd in Atlanta. We do routine maintenance, repairs and tire services for the people of Atlanta and the surrounding areas.
Our mantra is simple: there's only one way to fix a vehicle, the right way, the first time. Our ASE certified technicians work on foreign and domestic vehicles, from small cars to big diesel trucks.
Customers often mention our team by name, including Fernando, George, Marita and Rosio. Come by our clean, professional shop or give us a call to set up a visit.

## Services
- Engine diagnostics and performance: Check engine light on or something just feels off? We find the cause before we fix it.
- Diesel engine repair: We work on diesel engines, from big trucks down to smaller vehicles.
- Climate control systems: Heating and AC problems diagnosed and repaired, including tricky ones a reviewer said had the dealership puzzled.
- Steering and suspension: Repairs to keep your vehicle handling the way it should.
- Lube, oil and filter change: Routine maintenance to keep your vehicle running well between bigger services.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and closed on Saturday and Sunday.

Q: How do I schedule a service?
A: Call us or send a service request online. Submitting a request doesn't lock in a time, but we'll be in touch within 24 hours to find a time that works for you.

Q: Do you work on trucks as well as cars?
A: Yes. One reviewer put it this way: big diesel trucks to small vehicles, all done here.
